facts.business: PI Industries Limited is a science-led life sciences enterprise spanning crop protection, biologicals and human health, evolving from an agrisciences foundation to a globally relevant innovator with India at its core.

capacity_or_capex.item: Green capex for manufacturing resilience and environmental infrastructure

guidance_or_targets.statement: Increase renewable energy to 30% of total energy consumption by 2030
guidance_or_targets.metric: Renewable energy share of total energy consumption

guidance_or_targets.statement: Increase renewable electricity to 40% of electricity mix by 2030
guidance_or_targets.metric: Renewable electricity share of electricity mix

guidance_or_targets.statement: Reduce GHG emissions intensity by 20% to 5 tCO2e per MT of physical output by 2030

key_risks: Climate physical risks: heatwaves, water stress, monsoon variability, drought, coastal flooding affecting Gujarat manufacturing cluster and China sourcing
Transition risks: regulatory scrutiny, distributor preference shifts toward sustainable sourcing, carbon border regulations, technology obsolescence
Geographic concentration risk in Gujarat manufacturing cluster and China sourcing exposure
